newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Japan writes off $80 mln debt to Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: Japan writes off $80 mln debt to Bangladesh.

text.p: Japan has written off 9.14 billion yen ($80 million) in unpaid debt to Bangladesh, government officials said on Wednesday.
The debt relief came after an agreement signed between the two governments in Dhaka on Wednesday.
The officials said Tokyo had turned the loan into grant assistance for import of commodities and equipment.
But, they said, the agreement made it mandatory that the imports would be from member countries of the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD), of which Japan is a member.
Bangladesh is one of the largest beneficiaries of Japanese overseas aid programmes, having received more than $5 billion since 1971, the officials said.
